proofs.race_free:
by
  let final := finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())
  refine ⟨final, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · have htrace : final.trace = traceData := by
      rfl
    rw [htrace]
    decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  let final := finalState ops input outside
  refine ⟨final, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · constructor
    ·                                        
                                                                                         
                                                                   
      have htrace : final.trace = traceData := by
                                                                                    
                                                                                         
                                                                        
        rfl
      rw [htrace]
      decide
    ·                                                
                                                                         
                                                                                 
      rfl
